contract.multi_owner_registration: The same callback can be registered independently by different plugin owners
contract.ownership_separation: Each registration retains its own plugin ownership identity
contract.registry_preservation: Multi-owner registration produces separate listener entries
contract.delivery: Both owner-specific listener entries receive the emitted event
contract.callback_identity: Both listener entries may reference the same callback object
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful with multiple owners using the same callback
contract.permission_enforcement: Each registration and event emission requires the events permission
